description: Loads the self-improvement loop rule at session start and enforces the session-note cadence on stop

hooks.command: jq 'if .stop_hook_active == true then empty else {decision:"block",reason:"Before stopping, update the active docs/notes/<session-slug>.md note per the self-improvement loop rule with anything noteworthy from this turn (developer corrections, non-trivial discoveries, struggles, skill gaps, inconsistencies). If genuinely nothing was noteworthy, stop again and leave the note unchanged. Do not write a reply to the developer for this check."} end' || exit 0
